test_config_setter_getter: test the spdl pipeline config setter and getter functions for hook, queue, and profile settings
run_config_test_suite: run the unittest suite that validates default hook class, queue class, and profile hook configuration
set_default_hook_class: set a custom TaskHook subclass as the default hook class for the spdl pipeline
set_default_queue_class: set a custom StatsQueue subclass as the default queue class for the spdl pipeline
reset_pipeline_config: reset all pipeline configuration defaults including hook class, queue class, profile hook, and profile callback
